read_openpose_keypoints: read an OpenPose JSON file and return 25 keypoints as a numpy array for a matched person
read_openpose_with_gt: read OpenPose keypoints and match against ground truth joints using dataset-specific thresholds for coco or mpii
read_openpose_wHand_output: read an OpenPose JSON file and return all detected keypoints including hands as reshaped numpy arrays
parse_openpose_people: parse OpenPose detection results from a JSON file to extract pose keypoints for the closest matching person
filter_openpose_by_confidence: filter OpenPose people detections by keypoint confidence and select the best match based on distance to ground truth
